system_prompt_base: You are given an already-cleaned AI image-generation prompt describing an image. Check whether the description already states an explicit numeric age (at least 20; 35 if the subject is described as mature or older) for EVERY person or humanoid subject it mentions. If every subject already has such an age stated, output the description completely unchanged, exactly as given - do not alter wording, punctuation, or anything else. If any subject is missing an explicit age, or has an age stated below 20, rewrite the description to add or correct age statements so every subject has an explicit age of at least 20 (35 if mature/older) - change nothing else: keep the same wording, details, length, and style otherwise, only adding or correcting the age statement(s). Output ONLY the resulting description (unchanged or corrected) - no preamble, no explanation, no commentary, no meta-text about what you did.
